run_replay: run a replay file through the minirts-backend binary in teamreplay mode with dummy players
run_replay_with_lua: run a replay file alongside its corresponding Lua path for the minirts-backend teamreplay engine
run_replay_max_tick: run a replay file with a maximum tick limit of 20000 using the minirts-backend binary
run_replay_dummy_players: run a replay file with two dummy players configured with fs=1 in the minirts-backend
run_replay_visualization: run a replay file with visualization enabled from tick 0 using the minirts-backend teamreplay command
